plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix tracks that never played (silently skipped) when YouTube refuses the fast stream address: the fallback now fetches the track afresh, and retries with other clients. Includes 1.4.8.2 (brand accounts).
